name: v139_debt_delta90_user_baseline
hypothesis: Companies reducing debt over the recent quarter should have improving balance-sheet risk; this directly tests the user's proposed debt-decrease idea before adding confirmations.
notes: Direct baseline for rank(-ts_delta(debt,90)); TOP3000 delay1 via settings, industry neutralization via settings.

name: v139_total_debt_asset_slope_clean
hypothesis: Debt reduction should be measured relative to the asset base rather than nominal balance-sheet scale. A one-year debt/assets slope may isolate true deleveraging from firm-size effects.
expression: 0.560 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt_lt / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.120 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5))
notes: Avoids static debt/assets dominance already present in multiple ACTIVE alphas; uses change in total and long-term debt ratios.

name: v139_short_debt_pressure_relief
hypothesis: Reduction in current debt and interest paid is a sharper solvency improvement than total debt level alone, especially when short-maturity refinancing pressure is easing.
expression: 0.430 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt_st / assets, 126), 126), industry) + 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt_st / assets, 126), industry) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * net_interest_paid / assets, 126), industry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Tests short-debt pressure rather than ordinary low total debt; strict-check against static debt/assets actives.

name: v139_netdebt_delivery_surprise
hypothesis: Actual annual net debt below analyst consensus, plus downward net-debt estimate revision, indicates delivered deleveraging that analysts did not fully price.
expression: 0.430 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_netdebt_value - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_netdebt_mean) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_netdebt_mean / assets, 63), 126), industry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_netdebt_number, 63), 126), industry) + 0.090 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.060 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Uses annual actual-vs-estimate net-debt delivery, not the 1QF net-debt estimate parent occupied by d5xK1kmg.

name: v139_netdebt_guidance_tightening
hypothesis: Management guiding lower and tighter net-debt ranges is a forward-looking deleveraging signal distinct from historical debt balances.
expression: 0.420 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_netdebt_maxguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_netdebt_minguidance) / (2 * assets), 63), 126), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_netdebt_maxguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_netdebt_minguidance) / (2 * assets), 126), industry) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_netdebt_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_netdebt_minguidance) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.100 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.070 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Forward-looking net-debt guidance; strict-check against QPaze5zX because guidance sleeves can share slow-quality PnL.

name: v139_net_debt_paydown_flow
hypothesis: Repaying debt while avoiding new debt issuance is cleaner than raw repayment amount. The net financing flow should capture active balance-sheet repair.
expression: 0.440 * group_rank(ts_rank((debt_repayments_total_2 - debt_issuance_proceeds_2) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt_carrying_amount_total / assets, 126), 126), industry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt_instrument_interest_rate_percent, 126), industry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Fixes v138 debt repayment weakness by subtracting issuance proceeds and using debt carrying-amount decline.

name: v139_interest_coverage_improvement
hypothesis: Debt reduction is most investable when it improves interest coverage. Rising operating income per interest burden and falling interest/assets should identify lower financial stress.
expression: 0.410 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(operating_income / abs(interest_expense), 126), 126), subindustry) + 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(interest_expense / assets, 126), 126), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.130 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5))
notes: Coverage improvement instead of debt level; avoid FCF/value-sales legs to reduce overlap with existing quality/value actives.

name: v139_social_deleveraging_calm
hypothesis: A calm social/buzz regime can help distinguish underreacted balance-sheet repair from crowded low-debt quality. The parent change from v137 is debt-ratio slope, not static net debt.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) < 0.66, 0.320 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(net_debt_amount / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 180), industry) + 0.210 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 180), industry) + 0.120 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.100 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 126), industry), -1)
notes: Repair of social+netdebt near miss using net-debt slope instead of static level; strict-check against social and net-debt actives.

name: v139_model_cashflow_deleveraging
hypothesis: Cashflow efficiency rank should matter more when leverage is actively falling and interest payments are restrained; this tests a model/fundamental hybrid distinct from pure debt or pure cashflow.
expression: 0.360 * rank(cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative) + 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * net_interest_paid / assets, 126), industry) + 0.090 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.060 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Touches model16 after scanning dataset families, but only as a confirmer for deleveraging and interest burden relief.
